description: This file is a shell script used for configuring Quality of Service (QoS) settings on network interfaces in an OpenWRT environment. It contains functions for loading kernel modules, configuring network interfaces, parsing QoS rules, and managing tc and iptables firewall rules for traffic shaping and classification.

methods.name: add_insmod
methods.description: Loads a kernel module if not already loaded, based on the specified module name.

methods.name: find_ifname
methods.description: Finds the device name for a given network interface or outputs an error if not found.

methods.name: parse_matching_rule
methods.description: Constructs iptables rules with different match options based on network rule options.

methods.name: config_cb
methods.description: Callback for parsing interface and classification configurations from the QoS config.

methods.name: enum_classes
methods.description: Enumerates QoS classes and assigns class numbers.

methods.name: cls_var
methods.description: Sets class-specific variables for QoS configuration.

methods.name: tcrules
methods.description: Generates traffic control rules via an awk script.

methods.name: start_interface
methods.description: Initializes and applies QoS settings on a specific network interface.

methods.name: start_interfaces
methods.description: Starts QoS for all configured interfaces.

methods.name: add_rules
methods.description: Adds iptables rules for traffic classification and marking.

methods.name: start_cg
methods.description: Starts a QoS class group, setting up iptables chains and rules for it.

methods.name: start_firewall
methods.description: Sets up the firewall rules and chains for QoS management.

methods.name: stop_firewall
methods.description: Removes QoS-related iptables rules and chains to clean up the firewall configuration.
